person.persName: اينال باي بن قجماس بن أسن
اينال باي بن قجماس بن أسن

relation.note: Grandfather (father of Qajmās) = Anaṣ, the father of al-Ẓāhir Barqūq (AIND-D02178); confirmed by the entry of the grandson Yūsuf (AIND-D10454), which states Qajmās was the brother of "al-Ẓāhir Barqūq b. Anaṣ." Barqūq's father has no independent biography in the corpus, so active is left empty.
He was the son of al-Ẓāhir Barqūq's brother (i.e. Barqūq was his paternal uncle).
His son Yūsuf b. Īnāl Bāy b. Qajmās (AIND-D10454), in whose entry he is discussed.

person.note: アイナール・バーイ・ブン・カジュマース・ブン・アサン。アッ＝ザーヒル・バルクークの兄弟の子（甥）。810年にガッザで殺害された。彼の息子ユースフ（＝AIND-D10454）の項で言及される。
Aynāl Bāy b. Qajmās b. Asan, the son of al-Ẓāhir Barqūq's brother (his paternal nephew). He was killed in Ghazza in the year 810 AH. He is mentioned in the biography of his son Yūsuf (AIND-D10454).
